ideas.name: with the opening drive (the first 15 minutes' direction)
ideas.why: the opening drive is the overnight imbalance being worked; it sets the day's side

ideas.name: after a narrow first hour (IB under half an ADR)
ideas.why: a narrow initial balance leaves the day's range to come: a range-expansion day

ideas.name: the first hour not broken the other way first
ideas.why: a day that has already failed a break the other way is rotating, not trending

ideas.name: on the trade's side of yesterday's final VWAP
ideas.why: yesterday's average price is where yesterday's holders break even; above it they are long and comfortable

ideas.name: on the trade's side of yesterday's midpoint
ideas.why: the prior day's balance point; a breakout above it has yesterday's range below as support

ideas.name: a narrow overnight (under 0.4 ADR)
ideas.why: a quiet night leaves orders unfilled; the cash session expands the range and breakouts run

ideas.name: with a 3-session close streak
ideas.why: three closes the same way are a multi-day order being worked; intraday breakouts with it have it behind them

ideas.name: fewer than 2 losing trades earlier today
ideas.why: two failed breakouts mark a range day; the third meets the same edges
